## Formal verdict

All VB rails GREEN on the committed CSV
(`benchmarks/results/2026-08-26-sandbox-t3.csv`):
- 336 T3 rows: audits agree, NET identity holds, round-trips clean
- 168 T3 families: B-RANS within +0.50 pct of B-IDEAL
- 24 T3CELL rows: decomposition cross-check passes

**T3 bar(i) readout (tokenization = ZFFCTRL, winning token per history):**

| image | MED net | best non-MED | non-MED net | margin |
|-------|---------|-------------|-------------|--------|
| kodim01.ppm | 508863 | W | 542400 | -6.59 pct |
| kodim05.ppm | 554296 | W | 568922 | -2.64 pct |
| kodim13.ppm | 604935 | W | 614445 | -1.57 pct |
| kodim20.ppm | 391785 | W | 397839 | -1.55 pct |

Quad median margin: **-2.11 pct** (min -6.59 / max -1.55) vs bar >= +1.50.

**T3 bar(i) VERDICT: FAIL** - best non-MED family (W) is worse than MED
everywhere; GAP and W take their third and final strike; B3/B5 close
permanently. The T3b canary does NOT ride (bar(i) not met). T4
composition proceeds with {MED only} x D4c color trials.
